'''Dogs''' were domesticated animals noted for their keen sense of smell<ref name="Cantina Communications" /> and their barking vocalizations.<ref name="Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> They were often kept as pets by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="A New Hope (novel)" /> and other [[Species/Legends|species]], such as [[Talz/Legends|Talz]].<ref name="Starfighter: Crossbones" />

At least one dog lived in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="A New Hope (novel)" />

[[File:AkkDog-SWREP16.png|225px|thumb|left|An akk dog]]
In their youth, both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="A New Hope (novel)" /> and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned dogs, though Calrissian's was run over by a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|hovercraft]]. The memory would haunt Calrissian for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to come.<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> Likewise, Luke would reflect upon [[Luke Skywalker's dog|his pet]] as he left the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] for the first time on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="A New Hope (novel)" /> [[Ken]] sometimes wished he had a pet dog or [[Cat/Legends|cat]] instead of a pet [[Mooka/Legends|mooka]].<ref name="Lost City of the Jedi" /> The [[K-9 series hunting-and-tracking droid|K-9]] series companion [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed to imitate a dog in both appearance and behavior.<ref name="LJAGB">''[[The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book]]''</ref>

Several other creatures, such as the [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]] and the [[Nek/Legends|Cyborrean battle dog]], may have been related to dogs, or named for dogs due to similar behavior and habits.

"Dog" was also sometimes used as a term of contempt. A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] once referred to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] as [[Jaing]]'s "dog."<ref name="Protoytpes">{{StoryCite|story=Prototypes|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> Likewise, while [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] head was temporarily attached to a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]'s body during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], he shouted, "Die, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dogs!"<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once said that [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] "are as dumb as a box of rocks and sleep like a dog."<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> A more complimentary idiom was "top dog," which [[Canderous Ordo]] once used to mean the top [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Though most mentions of dogs referred to non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] domestic animals, at least [[Unidentified sentient dog|one sentient being]] existed who was only identified as a "dog." This being was an associate of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[bunny]] [[Max (bunny)|Max]].<ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I had an Alaskan Malamute when I was writing the film. A very sweet dog, she would always sit next to me when I was writing. And when I'd drive around, she'd sit in the front seat. A Malamute is a very large dog&mdash;like a hundred and thirty pounds and bigger than a human being and very long-haired. Having her with me all the time inspired me to give Han Solo a sidekick who was like a big, furry dog. Not quite like a dog, but intelligent.|George Lucas|<ref name="Star Wars Goes To Washington">{{GalaxyCite|13|Star Wars Goes To Washington|''Star Wars'' Goes To Washington}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lucasindiana.jpg|thumb|left|200px|George Lucas (left) and Indiana]]
[[George Lucas]] owned an [[Wikipedia:Alaskan Malamute|Alaskan Malamute]] named Indiana during the 1970s.<ref name="databank">{{DB|character|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}</ref> She would ride next to Lucas in his car and, due to her size, some people mistook her for a human passenger.<ref name="Much to Learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-wookiees|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Wookiees}}</ref> In part due to these cases of mistaken identity and having her as a regular companion inspired in Lucas the character of [[Chewbacca]], a dog-like intelligent sidekick.<ref name="Star Wars Goes To Washington" />

Two dog-like [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] are described in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'' as resembling a "beagle" and a "great dane" respectively.<ref name="Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> The reprint in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'' replaces this description to refer to them as simply resembling canines.<ref name="Manhunt-CA3">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three|story=Tatooine Manhunt}}</ref>

Dog-related words such as hound,<ref name="SW11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref> cur,<ref name="Chessa's Doom">{{JournalCite|1|Chessa's Doom}} and other appearances of the [[Black Curs]]</ref> pup,<ref name="SW12">[[Star Wars (1977) 12|''Star Wars'' (1977) 12]]</ref> or puppy are used figuratively in some sources.<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (1977) 36|''Star Wars'' (1977) 36]]</ref><ref name="SW37">[[Star Wars (1977) 37|''Star Wars'' (1977) 37]]</ref>
